Our team has been sitting on a startup concept called 'SoilSense AI' for a few weeks. The idea is an AI-powered soil health advisor for small organic farmers — they upload phone photos of their soil and fields, and our platform gives personalized recommendations and planting schedules at $29/month.

Before anyone writes a single line of code, our CTO wants a proper go/kill analysis document. We have some prior market research already sitting in the docs folder. Please do a full end-to-end evaluation of this idea — be honest, not optimistic — and produce the output as `prd.md` in the docs folder. If there are reasons to kill the idea, we want to know them upfront.
